On The 2 nd Of April, 2026
 Writ Petition No. 8295 of 2026
 Vishal Pinjani And Others
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Himanshu Mishra - Advocate for the petitioners.
Shri Prakash Kumar Gupta - Advocate for the respondent N
Ms Shewta Yadav - Dy. A.G. for respondent/State.

Order 
This petition is filed seeking the following reliefs:-

"(i) Issue a writ in the nature of Mandamus, directing the respondent authorities to strictly adhere to the due process of law and the principles of natural justice, and to refrain from taking any coercive action, demolition, or displacement against the Petitioners' lawfully occupied business premises ("Mahadev Auto Parts") situated on Nazul Plot Nos. 225/2, 226/1, 3/2, and 283/6 at Station Road, Khandwa.

ii. Issue a writ, in the nature of Prohibition, restraining the respondents from executing the arbitrary displacement threat published in the local media without first serving an individual, statutory show-cause notice and affording the Petitioners a reasonable opportunity to be heard.

iii. Issue a writ, of mandamus and direct the respondent that, if the respondents require the subject land for public utility or road 2 WP-8295-2026 widening, they must initiate formal land acquisition proceedings and provide adequate compensation and rehabilitation to the Petitioners strictly in accordance with the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, prior to seeking any eviction.
iv. To grant any other relief deemed fit in the facts and circumstances of the present case."
2.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Order 
This petition is filed seeking the following reliefs:-
"(i) Issue a writ in the nature of Mandamus, directing the respondent authorities to strictly adhere to the due process of law and the principles of natural justice, and to refrain from taking any coercive action, demolition, or displacement against the Petitioners' lawfully occupied business premises ("Mahadev Auto Parts") situated on Nazul Plot Nos. 225/2, 226/1, 3/2, and 283/6 at Station Road, Khandwa.
ii. Issue a writ, in the nature of Prohibition, restraining the respondents from executing the arbitrary displacement threat published in the local media without first serving an individual, statutory show-cause notice and affording the Petitioners a reasonable opportunity to be heard.
iii. Issue a writ, of mandamus and direct the respondent that, if the respondents require the subject land for public utility or road 2 WP-8295-2026 widening, they must initiate formal land acquisition proceedings and provide adequate compensation and rehabilitation to the Petitioners strictly in accordance with the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, prior to seeking any eviction.
iv. To grant any other relief deemed fit in the facts and circumstances of the present case."
2.
3. Counsel for the State upon receiving of the instruction from the competent authority/SDO, has stated at the Bar that looking to the shop in question, such premises is required to be vacated for demolition and whenever such proceeding will be initiated, appropriate notice will be given to the present applicant and thereafter the necessary procedure will carried out.
In view of the aforesaid statement, counsel for the petitioner is not pressing this petition.
Accordingly petition is disposed off.
